description_en: Queries the names of protected object groups
description_zh: 查询防护对象组名称列表
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-resource-group-names --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-lbj0000cc03 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseResourceGroupNames

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the protected object group that you want to query. Fuzzy query is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的防护对象组名称。您可以设置该参数，模糊查询已创建的防护对象组名称
parameters.name: group_name_like

parameters.help_en: The page number of the paginated results. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第 1 页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20, which indicates 20 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为20，表示每页包含 20 条结果
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: regions outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

GroupNames.description_en: The names of the protected object groups

items.description_en: The name of the protected object group

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
